name: Byte Budget
summary: A photo size slider with real JPEG compression, where the file block must fit under a size gate
about: A file-size helper for uploads with a limit. Quality and width sliders really re-compress the photo in your browser, a 4x lens shows the compression, and the file rides a belt as a block whose height is its size: too big and it bumps into the striped gate, small enough and it rolls under with a green light. Fit to limit searches for the best quality that fits and glides the sliders there.
how: Pick a limit: Profile 100 KB, Chat 250 KB or Email 1 MB
Drag the Quality and Width sliders (or use the arrow keys) and watch the real file size and the lens
Press Fit to limit to search for the sharpest version that fits, shrinking the width only if it must
Load your own photo with Your photo or drop it on the preview, then download the result
